description: Yardage for op=curtain (CSU Extension: finished width × fullness + 4 in per panel + 1 in per seam, cut length = length + 2 × hem + 2 × heading + casing + repeat) or op=backing (AQS: top + 4 or 8 in, ½ in piecing seams, both seam directions). units us (in) or metric (cm). Educational.

hem.description: curtain: single lower hem depth, default 4 in

length.description: curtain: finished length; backing: quilt top length

overage.description: backing: total extra each way, default 4 in up to 40 in else 8 in

overlap.description: curtain: overlap and returns, default 12 in

step.description: Round purchase up to this many yards (0.125, 0.25 or 0), default 0.125 curtain, 0.25 backing

usable_width.description: backing: usable fabric width, default 40 in

width.description: curtain: width to cover; backing: quilt top width

name: fabric_yardage
title: Fabric yardage for curtains or quilt backing
